CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2584 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 79888f045b89f4dc6c87e5f5d75688d41986a716. Bus nonce: ee6cea512b2ddaaa0f44a4aa4d7a3f0a. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 79888f045b89f4dc6c87e5f5d75688d41986a716`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 79888f045b89f4dc6c87e5f5d75688d41986a716` or `Fix review: blocked 79888f045b89f4dc6c87e5f5d75688d41986a716 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: ee6cea512b2ddaaa0f44a4aa4d7a3f0a`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `79888f045b89f4dc6c87e5f5d75688d41986a716` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2584 79888f045b89f4dc6c87e5f5d75688d41986a716") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2584-ee6cea51`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
RE-REVIEW, round 4, of PR #2584 (group R10-FLOW-MAIN-GATE, branch fix/r10-flow-main-gate) at head 79888f045b89f4dc6c87e5f5d75688d41986a716. The previous verdict at 37d1d0d3 was blocked merge-conflict (read it with `git fetch origin review/2584; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md`). Since then the fixer absorbed main 0b162da1 as merge commit 79888f04, with parents 37d1d0d3 and 0b162da1, and changed nothing else. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required. This is a delta review, so do not re-open what round 3 accepted unless the absorb changes it.
- The diff between 37d1d0d3 and the head, minus main's own changes, must be only the conflict resolution. Name anything else.
- dev/audit/harnesses/r10_seat_selftests_mutants.py must be the union with no side's mutant dropped: the PR's 23 per-file ids, main's body_patch-1, tick_loop and heartbeat, 65 ids all distinct. Compare `git show 37d1d0d3:<file>`, `git show 0b162da1:<file>` and the head using ast.
- The auto-merged files are merge_train.py, orchestrator_tick.py, INSTRUMENTS.md and tests/closures.json. Main's side there is #2585's rename to nightly.yml and the MAIN D-1 arm. Check that the semantics compose.
- Re-run the mutation harness (body: 72 KILLED, survivors=0) and the self-tests (merge_train 219/0, orchestrator_tick 194/0, merge_pr 18/0, wiring 77/77), each with a null control.
- carry_audit.py check over the body gives 0 unrouted. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 79888f045b89f4dc6c87e5f5d75688d41986a716 must be clean.
- Read check-runs at this head. A red whose log shows "API rate limit exceeded" is external; the installation limit was hit at 09:44Z. nightly-status and delivery-status are not required.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head, and VERDICT carries bus-nonce: ee6cea512b2ddaaa0f44a4aa4d7a3f0a. No /Users/ or /private/ path may appear in VERDICT.md or ev/.
